comparison.comparisonMethod: Keys use logical image, ecosystem/type, package name and advisory ID. Installed version and file path are evidence fields, not identity keys, so version or JAR filename changes do not inflate new/fixed vulnerabilities. Raw target occurrences and multiplicity changes remain separately counted. Newly reported scanner flags are not proof of newly introduced exploitable vulnerabilities.
comparison.scopeOfZeroApplicationFindingsClaim: Trivy full OS/library analysis of the24 exact final app image config IDs, under the recorded snapshot; not a claim that all possible vulnerabilities or JavaScript bundle dependencies are identifiable.
